title: As the much-hyped startup Essential runs into troubles, a smaller company called OnePlus shows the right way to compete with Apple and Samsung (AAPL, GOOGL, GOOG)
text: As the much-hyped startup Essential runs into troubles, a smaller company called OnePlus shows the right way to compete with Apple and Samsung (AAPL, GOOGL, GOOG) By Antonio Villas-Boas Oct 20, 2018, 9:00 am 27 pts Essential, the smartphone company founded by Android co-creator Andy Rubin, isn't showing many signs of success.
